summary: The Zoka-ol-Molk I is an oil-on-cotton-duck painting by Iranian realist painter Kamal-ol-molk, created in 1913. It portrays Mohammad Hossein Foroughi, who is titled Zoka-ol-Molk I and is the father of Mohammad Ali Foroughi, titled Zoka-ol-Molk II. The note is a brief entry describing the painting's medium, date and subject.
one_line: A 1913 oil-on-cotton-duck portrait by Kamal-ol-molk of Mohammad Hossein Foroughi, known as Zoka-ol-Molk I.
key_facts: The Zoka-ol-Molk I is a painting by the Iranian realism painter Kamal-ol-molk.
The painting is executed in oil on cotton duck.
The painting features a portrait of Mohammad Hossein Foroughi.
Mohammad Hossein Foroughi is titled Zoka-ol-Molk I.
Mohammad Hossein Foroughi is the father of Mohammad Ali Foroughi.
Mohammad Ali Foroughi is titled Zoka-ol-Molk II.
